\paragraph{Operating constraints and evidence.} 
% Shared source: ANT-SYS-FR-001
The system feasibility assessment must identify a common mass, epoch, orbit/RAAN, duty-cycle, response and resource baseline for each combined margin and disclose incompatible evidence rather than pool it. Existing studies differ in epoch/mass/response and completion.

\paragraph{Feasibility assessment.} The design-maturity statement above is conditional: missing essential allocations cannot all be deferred as detailed PDR work. Software and model evidence supports only its stated scope. Corrected DITL evidence supersedes the prior annual truncation finding; logger/configuration closure remains conditional. The centralized register separates concept blockers from later qualification and records exact parents, interfaces and closure methods.
